title: Indonesia President Prabowo apologises to Singapore, Malaysia over transboundary haze
paragraphs: Indonesia President Prabowo apologises to Singapore, Malaysia over transboundary haze
Prabowo also said 16 firefighters had died and two helicopters were lost battling forest fires that had raged for nearly four months.
MANILA: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto apologised on Sunday (Nov 15) for the transboundary haze from forest and land fires in his country that has affected Singapore and Malaysia.
